label: copy phase of length-3 sequences (outputs 2 and 3)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never during the original tokens or on <DEL>. The core is length-3 sequences: on both copy-input steps (t=4, 5) it fires about 97% of the time and holds about 76% of activation mass. It is strongest at t=5 (output of the last original token, input = orig(1)), where nearly all top activations sit near max; t=4 is about 0.3-0.4 of max. The remaining ~24% of mass is weak, scattered firing on the last two copy steps (to_go <= 1) of longer sequences, mostly L=4 and L=6-9. It fires at only a few percent of those steps, with a mild preference for inputs h/o/2, and no clean predicate captures it. Overall recall by count is therefore low (~0.39). Never fires on first occurrences of a token or before the delimiter.
